P-29.hypothesis: Analytical model suggests 0.05 mL/min resolution is theoretically achievable at low field. Power consumption is theoretically within implantable budget.
P-29.experiment: Feasibility study: build miniaturized NMR coil + magnet prototype, measure SNR in mock CSF at 0.1T. Cost: $25K. Timeline: 16 weeks. HIGH RISK — may show miniaturization is infeasible.
P-29.pass_rule: SNR > 5:1 at 0.1 mL/min flow in mock CSF at 0.1T with prototype coil <5mm diameter
P-29.fail_rule: SNR < 3:1 OR coil diameter >10mm required OR power >100 μW
